decisions.reason: This custom in-ear earmold builds directly on the firm's established hearing-care know-how, customer relationships, and in-house R&D, so management expects to improve it rather than withdraw it.
The vacuum thermoforming unit fits the firm's existing equipment, laboratory-process, and service capabilities, giving it strong absorptive capacity to learn from use and refine the product.

Despite some overlap in custom manufacturing methods, the orthopedic shoe last is too far from the firm's core markets and accumulated knowledge base for efficient learning, support, and commercial development.

The post-curing unit is closely related to the firm's digital production and materials workflow expertise, although its newer and less prominent market presence makes management somewhat more cautious.
